sources.label: Official Miss Selfridge size guide ('Women / Miss Selfridge', cm, product-page Size Guide on ASOS; missselfridge.com now redirects to ASOS, which owns the brand)

audit: Old source was an ASOS brand listing, not a guide. Miss Selfridge has its own guide on ASOS (guide 235, not the ASOS DESIGN chart). Official UK 4–16: UK 8 bust 83→82, waist 66→64, hips 88→88.5; UK 12 bust 91→92, hips 96→98.5; UK 14 bust 97 (same), waist 80→79, hips 102→103.5; UK 16 bust 103→102, waist 86→84. UK 4 added. The guide lists UK 18 with no measurements, so it is left out. The table's column order is Bust | Hip | Waist; values were mapped by header.
